description: Compare state income tax for one tax year only when every requested state has an explicit calculation profile.

earlyRetirementDistributionSubjectToPena.description: Part of the taxable retirement distributions subject to the federal 10% early-distribution tax

federalTaxableIncome.description: Federal taxable income (Form 1040 line 15); required for states that start from it, such as North Dakota

filingStatus.description: Filing status (default: single; married means married filing jointly)

incomeBeforeStateDeductions.description: Annual income before modeled state deductions

netLongTermCapitalGain.description: Net long-term capital gain included in the income above (Washington capital gains excise)

states.description: Array of state codes to compare (e.g., ['CA', 'TX', 'WA', 'NY'])

taxYear.description: Tax year for all versioned state calculation profiles

taxableRetirementDistributions.description: Taxable retirement distributions included in the income above

taxableSocialSecurityBenefits.description: Federally taxable Social Security included in the income above; states that do not exclude it fail closed

name: compare_state_taxes
